author: Mr_Mushroom99
body:
Hi my old IGN is paperwite and is still my main. But I was banned on 4 other accounts for bypassing. Paperwite was banned for excessive infractions. Although, I was not aware of it. I should have been smart to check on forums but I feel as if I was too lazy. If I don't get accepted back into the advices network i understand. But, I would love to come back and enjoy the good old times. I was on advices since it was mczone. I have loved it ever since! This ban I know is not false and I have many reasons not to be accepted back. I would really love to come back because I have made some life-long friends there that I enjoy playing with. I also need to stay active with my team. I know I will not get accepted back. But if you guys change your mind. I'm always open to come back in. When I wake up every morning I get on minecraft and try get to on advices but I then remember I am banned. Ever since I was banned I wish i could go back and change the past. I am heart broken about being banned. So i worked hard to get more accounts on minecraft but sadly I was banned for bypassing and i have no more accounts. I have learned my lesson and I will never bypass again, or get any more infractions. I would rather get a temp ban for 3 weeks instead of a perm ban. I am very sad I can't get on avicus. In that was I got alts and used them to have my happiness. Sometimes I even cry about not being on avicus. It was my favourite server since mczone and it still is. But sadly I might have to let that go and get a new server. I have many infractions. And I have the reason to be banned. You guys are just making a safe environment for the server Which I understand. I would be happy to just watch everyone play the games in spectate mode and see everyone having fun. I used to have so many good times on this server and I have so many good memories. Bering banned from the server almost made me quit minecraft. But the reason I didn't is because my little sister begged me to teach her how to play. And now I accidentally got banned on the account she was using. So now our favourite server is Mineplex in which we play every day together. 

So if you need to contact me, contact me by email @scrumb@telus.net I would like to hear feedback as soon as possible. Everything I wrote her is true.

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

I really appreciate the effort you put into this appeal, I love it. However, you've ban evaded 4 times, something which we're very strict about. You will not be appealed this time around, however don't feel afraid to try again 6 months, and put just as much effort in, it will be a straight forward appeal.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
